import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/** Runs proc Calc: `POST /api/calc` on http server web-api. */
export async function calc(args: { readonly l: readonly number[] }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/calc", {
    "l": $encList($encInt)(args.l),
  }, opts);
  return $decInt(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_CalcArgs(x: $t.CalcArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "l": $encList($encInt)(x.l),
  };
}

export function $dec_CalcArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.CalcArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    l: $decList($decInt)($field(o, "l", at), at + ".l"),
  };
}

==== hooks.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";

/**
 * Runs proc Calc through calc (`POST /api/calc` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useCalc(args?: { readonly l: readonly number[] } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly l: readonly number[] }, number> {
  return $useCall($c.calc, args, opts);
}
